page.layout: One printed page. A table of consular names with years in a right-hand column, one ruled block per year group. Notes in the left margin. Running head at top centre, page number top left, catchword at bottom right.

main_text.l: Albertus Bavarius Comes Hollandiae, &c. confirmat Groninganis jus negotiationum per provincias suas. |

page.notes: The year 1359 is printed in a worn form (first digit looks like J); read as 1359 with doubt. The left-margin notes are set beside the table rows; the asterisk note is keyed to the 1365 row. The catchword "Harmen" stands at the foot right under the last table row. The page lies at the head of a printed table; no further text is present. Long s is rendered as plain s in names such as Maurissingh.
